method: Native OfflineAudioContext renders a two-channel opposite-polarity ramp through final ScratchEngine source; forward/reverse slopes and stereo alignment are measured, with silence after 70ms. This is output-sample evidence, not physical-device listening.
reproduce: Copy audio-scratch-native-probe.astro.txt to apps/doc/webmusic/src/pages/scratch-qa.astro temporarily, run documentation dev server, open /scratch-qa/ and press Render PCM checks. Remove the temporary route afterwards.
